detailed_descriptions.en: Just as one bad apple spoils the bunch, the wrong equipment can spell doom for a heister on the job. To prevent such pitfalls, the Syntax Error Weapon Pack provides you with 3 brand new weapons to help beef up your arsenal. This pack contains the following: SMG - 'WAR-45': High Power, Lower fire rate Shotgun - 'FSA-12G': medium power, high fire rate, semi auto, magazine loaded Marksman - 'FIK 22 TLR': low power, high fire rate, very accurate Weapon Charm - 'Whistleblower' Weapon Sticker - 'BSOD'

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Just as one bad apple spoils the bunch, the wrong equipment can spell doom for a heister on the job. To prevent such pitfalls, the Syntax Error Weapon Pack provides you with 3 brand new weapons to help beef up your arsenal.

This pack contains the following:
  • SMG - 'WAR-45': High Power, Lower fire rate
  • Shotgun - 'FSA-12G': medium power, high fire rate, semi auto, magazine loaded
  • Marksman - 'FIK 22 TLR': low power, high fire rate, very accurate
  • Weapon Charm - 'Whistleblower'
  • Weapon Sticker - 'BSOD'
